scope: Development ISO: real GUI installation and strict guest backup/UI tests; later iterator/reset source changes require a new build

checks: Real GUI installer creates TMCBFS2 spanning the actual data partition, imports current live files and account; target was never host-formatted
Installed NVMe boot without ISO authenticates imported account, reads imported file and performs real shared-root CoW restore
Internal native Recovery runs the SAME installer as Reinstalla, verifies FS2 data/snapshots and sealed system; complete data-partition SHA unchanged by reinstall
After reinstall and reboot, imported account, documents and existing snapshot remain usable
TextEdit opens and saves a 128KiB file through the modern chooser, with byte-exact streamed readback beyond the old 8KiB limit
Actual Finder navigates beyond 384 entries and reaches file 1099 using bounded pages through real syscalls
Actual Time Machine reaches and verifies snapshot 20 on the third timeline page
Actual modern TextEdit picker reaches and opens file 1099, beyond the old directory-slot ceiling
Native internal Recovery creates the scalable local backup using shared-root CoW, not a volume-sized copy
Local backup restores account, changed document and 128KiB file after reboot while pre-existing snapshots remain valid
Setup password caret hidden until typing, then blinks without plaintext; UTF8-safe caret editing authenticates the resulting password
Only the file panel has no extra window frame; background Finder remains visible and open
Other apps remain usable while the file panel is open; switching back preserves the pending dialog and document
Save panel creates and enters a real user folder
First Save opens native chooser and writes the selected path
Saved file content and version verified through real Terminal/filesystem
Finder button removed; former target cannot launch another window
Open chooser browses folders and loads the selected file into TextEdit
Toolbar Apri opens the modern chooser; cancel preserves the loaded document
File menu Apri documento opens the same modern chooser
Mouse Cancel in unsaved-changes confirmation preserves the document
Dirty Ctrl+O confirmation opens modern chooser; canceling that chooser still preserves unsaved bytes
Overwrite confirmation can be canceled without losing the document
Readonly destinations rejected in the actual save sheet
Canceled and rejected saves leave existing file bytes unchanged
Locked-session password caret and unlock work
